title: Too & Enough
objectives: Use too & enough accurately in A2 contexts.
Understand form, meaning, and typical usage.
Produce short spoken and written examples.
canDo: I can use too and enough with adjectives and nouns.

warmUp.title: Activate prior knowledge
warmUp.prompt: Before this lesson, recall what you know about too & enough. How is it similar or different from Portuguese?
reflectionQuestions: When do native speakers use too & enough?
Can you think of one example?

explanation: Too + adj = excess (too hot) | Adj + enough (big enough) | Enough + noun (enough time)

grammar.title: Too & Enough
grammar.rule: Too + adj = excess (too hot) | Adj + enough (big enough) | Enough + noun (enough time)

reading.title: Too & Enough in Context
reading.text: The soup is too salty. The room isn't big enough for twenty people. Do we have enough money? There is plenty of food — too much, actually.

questions.question: What is the main topic of the text?
questions.explanation: The text illustrates this lesson topic.

questions.question: Is this text appropriate for A2 learners?
Which sentence best matches the lesson?

writing.prompt: Write a short paragraph (5–7 sentences) using too & enough. Use at least 3 words from the vocabulary list.
rubricHints: Use the target structure at least twice.
writing.modelAnswer: Too late to change. We have enough chairs. Plenty of time. Almost enough.

tutorHints: Correct gently and ask the learner to reformulate.
Use English for meta-language when possible at A2.
